parts.zh: W: 你今晚要为演讲者致一段简短的感谢词
W: 听起来你可不怎么热情
M: 不是。我其实并不介意
W: 为什么？发生了什么事？
M: 那时我才二十出头
M: 总之，我去听了一位叫 Bligh 小姐的讲座
M: 她准备用幻灯片讲讲我们镇在十八世纪中叶的情况
W: 我们都犯过这种错

items.stem: What is the man asked to do this evening?

choices.text: Say a few words to thank the speaker.
choices.zh: 说几句话感谢演讲者。

choices.text: Introduce the speaker to the audience.
choices.zh: 向听众介绍演讲者。

choices.text: Give a lecture on the history of the town.
choices.zh: 做一场关于该镇历史的讲座。

choices.text: Host a talk on how to give a good speech.
choices.zh: 主持一场关于如何做好演讲的讲座。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man?

choices.text: He was the founder of the local history society.
choices.zh: 他是当地历史学会的创始人。

choices.text: He has worked with Miss Bligh for 20 years.
choices.zh: 他与Miss Bligh共事了20年。

choices.text: He has published a book on public speaking.
choices.zh: 他出版过一本关于公开演讲的书。

choices.text: He joined the local history society when young.
choices.zh: 他年轻时加入了当地历史学会。

items.stem: What does the man say about Miss Bligh?

choices.text: She was obviously better at talking than writing.
choices.zh: 她显然更擅长讲话而非写作。

choices.text: She had a good knowledge of the town's history.
choices.zh: 她对该镇的历史了解颇深。

choices.text: Her speech was so funny as to amuse the audience.
choices.zh: 她的演讲非常有趣，逗乐了听众。

choices.text: Her ancestors came to the town in the 18th century.
choices.zh: 她的祖先在18世纪来到该镇。

items.stem: What does the man say about the first time he gave a speech of thanks?

choices.text: He read exactly what was written in his notes.
choices.zh: 他完全照着笔记上写的内容念。

choices.text: He kept forgetting what he was going to say.
choices.zh: 他不断忘记自己要说什么。

choices.text: He made an embarrassing remark.
choices.zh: 他说了一句令人尴尬的话。

choices.text: He was too nervous to speak up
choices.zh: 他太紧张以至于说不出话来。

items.stem: What does the woman think the man should know?

choices.text: What their retailers demand.
choices.zh: 他们的零售商有什么要求。

choices.text: What their rivals are doing.
choices.zh: 他们的竞争对手在做什么。

choices.text: How they are going to beat their rivals.
choices.zh: 他们将如何击败竞争对手。

choices.text: How dramatically the market is changing.
choices.zh: 市场变化有多剧烈。

items.stem: What does the woman think of Barratts Company?

choices.text: They should be taken seriously.
choices.zh: 应该认真对待他们。

choices.text: They are rapidly catching up.
choices.zh: 他们正在迅速赶上。

choices.text: Their business strategy is quite effective.
choices.zh: 他们的经营策略相当有效。

choices.text: Their potential has been underestimated.
choices.zh: 他们的潜力被低估了。

items.stem: What did the woman say about the letter from the tax revenue office?

choices.text: She had given it to Tom.
choices.zh: 她已经把它交给Tom了。

choices.text: It simply made her go frantic.
choices.zh: 它简直让她抓狂。

choices.text: She had not seen it yet.
choices.zh: 她还没有看到它。

choices.text: It was not much of a big concern.
choices.zh: 这不是什么大问题。

items.stem: What is the man thinking of doing?

choices.text: Restructuring the whole company.
choices.zh: 重组整个公司。

choices.text: Employing more forwarding agents.
choices.zh: 雇用更多货运代理。

choices.text: Promoting cooperation with Jayal Motors.
choices.zh: 促进与Jayal Motors的合作。

choices.text: Exporting their motorbikes to Indonesia.
choices.zh: 将他们的摩托车出口到印度尼西亚。

items.stem: What do we learn about the report released this month?

choices.text: It makes claims in conflict with the existing research.
choices.zh: 它提出了与现有研究相冲突的主张。

choices.text: It focuses on the link between bedtime and nutrition.
choices.zh: 它关注就寝时间与营养之间的联系。

choices.text: It cautions against the overuse of coffee and alcohol.
choices.zh: 它告诫不要过度使用咖啡和酒精。

choices.text: It shows that "night owls" work much less efficiently.
choices.zh: 它表明"夜猫子"的工作效率要低得多。

items.stem: What does the study from the University of California, Berkeley, find about teens who go to bed late?

choices.text: They pay greater attention to food choice.
choices.zh: 他们更加注重食物选择。

choices.text: They tend to achieve less than their peers.
choices.zh: 他们往往比同龄人成就更低。

choices.text: They run a higher risk of gaining weight.
choices.zh: 他们体重增加的风险更高。

choices.text: They stand a greater chance to fall sick.
choices.zh: 他们生病的可能性更大。

items.stem: What should "night owls" do to reduce their consumption of unhealthy food?

choices.text: Get up late.
choices.zh: 晚起。

choices.text: Sleep 8 hours a day.
choices.zh: 每天睡8小时。

choices.text: Exercise more.
choices.zh: 多运动。

choices.text: Go to bed earlier
choices.zh: 早点上床睡觉

items.stem: Why has the Oscars ceremony been criticized?

choices.text: All of the acting nominees are white.
choices.zh: 所有表演类提名者都是白人。

choices.text: It has got too much publicity on TV.
choices.zh: 它在电视上获得了过多的宣传。

choices.text: It is prejudiced against foreign films.
choices.zh: 它对外国电影存在偏见。

choices.text: Only 7% of the nominees are female.
choices.zh: 提名者中只有7%是女性。

items.stem: What do we learn from the research?

choices.text: 22 percent of movie directors were people of color.
choices.zh: 22%的电影导演是有色人种。

choices.text: Half of the TV programs were ethnically balanced.
choices.zh: 一半的电视节目在种族构成上是平衡的。

choices.text: Only one-fifth of TV shows had black characters.
choices.zh: 只有五分之一的电视节目有黑人角色。

choices.text: Only 3.4 percent of film directors were women.
choices.zh: 只有3.4%的电影导演是女性。

items.stem: Who are regarded as "largely invisible" on TV shows?

choices.text: Non-white males.
choices.zh: 非白人男性。

choices.text: Program creators.
choices.zh: 节目创作者。

choices.text: Females of color over 40.
choices.zh: 40岁以上有色人种女性。

choices.text: Asian speaking characters.
choices.zh: 亚裔说话角色。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Hispanics?

choices.text: They constitute 17% of Hollywood movie characters.
choices.zh: 他们构成好莱坞电影角色的17%。

choices.text: They are most underrepresented across TV and film.
choices.zh: 他们是电视和电影中代表性最不足的群体。

choices.text: They contribute little to the U. S. film industry.
choices.zh: 他们对美国电影业贡献甚微。

choices.text: They account for 8.5% of the U.S. population
choices.zh: 他们占美国人口的8.5%。

items.stem: What life insurance should a single person buy according to the speaker?

choices.text: One that can provide for emergency needs.
choices.zh: 能够满足紧急需求的保险。

choices.text: One that can pay for their medical expenses.
choices.zh: 能够支付医疗费用的保险。

choices.text: One that covers their debts and burial expenses
choices.zh: 能够覆盖债务和丧葬费用的保险。

choices.text: One that ensures a healthy life for their later years.
choices.zh: 能够确保晚年健康生活的保险。

items.stem: What should people do as their family increases in size?

choices.text: Purchase insurance for their children.
choices.zh: 为子女购买保险。

choices.text: Save sufficient money for a rainy day.
choices.zh: 存够足够的钱以备不时之需。

choices.text: Buy a home with a small down payment.
choices.zh: 以小额首付购买住房。

choices.text: Add more insurance on the breadwinner.
choices.zh: 为家庭经济支柱增加更多保险。

items.stem: When should one change their life insurance?

choices.text: When their children grow up and leave home.
choices.zh: 当子女长大离家时。

choices.text: When they have saved enough for retirement.
choices.zh: 当为退休存够足够的钱时。

choices.text: When their family moves to a different place.
choices.zh: 当家庭搬到不同的地方时。

choices.text: When they have found better-paying jobs.
choices.zh: 当找到薪酬更高的工作时。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about stereotypes?

choices.text: They do more harm than good.
choices.zh: 它们弊大于利。

choices.text: They have often been ignored.
choices.zh: 它们经常被忽视。

choices.text: They do not help build friendship.
choices.zh: 它们无助于建立友谊。

choices.text: They may not always be negative.
choices.zh: 它们可能并非总是负面的。

items.stem: What leads to the bias of stereotypes?

choices.text: Biased sources of information.
choices.zh: 有偏见的信息来源。

choices.text: Ignorance of cultural differences.
choices.zh: 对文化差异的无知。

choices.text: Misinterpretation of Shakespeare.
choices.zh: 对莎士比亚的误读。

choices.text: Tendency to jump to conclusions.
choices.zh: 急于下结论的倾向。

items.stem: What does the speaker say is a problem with stereotypes?

choices.text: They are hard to dismiss once attached to a certain group.
choices.zh: 一旦附着于某个群体就难以消除。

choices.text: They may have a negative impact on people they apply to.
choices.zh: 它们可能对所适用的人群产生负面影响。

choices.text: They persist even when circumstances have changed.
choices.zh: 即使情况已经改变它们仍然存在。

choices.text: They are often applied to minorities and ethnic people.
choices.zh: 它们常常适用于少数族裔和少数民族。

items.stem: What did one recent study find about stereotypes?

choices.text: They impact people more or less in the same way.
choices.zh: 它们对人们的影响或多或少是相同的。

choices.text: Some people are more sensitive to them than others.
choices.zh: 有些人比其他人对它们更敏感。

choices.text: A positive stereotype may help one achieve better results.
choices.zh: 积极的刻板印象可能帮助人取得更好的结果。

choices.text: A negative stereotype sticks while a positive one does not
choices.zh: 负面刻板印象持续存在而积极刻板印象则不会。

items.stem: What does the speaker say you should do when you have an adverse reaction?

choices.text: Use some over-the-counter medicine instead.
choices.zh: 使用一些非处方药代替。

choices.text: Quit taking the medicine immediately.
choices.zh: 立即停止服用该药物。

choices.text: Take some drug to relieve the side effect.
choices.zh: 服用某种药物来缓解副作用。

choices.text: Ask your pharmacist to explain why it occurs.
choices.zh: 询问你的药剂师解释为什么会发生这种情况。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about alcohol drinking?

choices.text: It may help patients fall asleep.
choices.zh: 它可能帮助患者入睡。

choices.text: It may lead to mental problems.
choices.zh: 它可能导致精神问题。

choices.text: It may cause serious harm to one's liver.
choices.zh: 它可能对肝脏造成严重伤害。

choices.text: It may increase the effect of certain drugs.
choices.zh: 它可能增强某些药物的效果。

items.stem: What does the speaker call on parents to do at the end of the talk?

choices.text: Tell their children to treat medicines with respect.
choices.zh: 告诉他们的孩子要尊重对待药物。

choices.text: Keep medicines out of the reach of their children.
choices.zh: 将药物放在孩子够不到的地方。

choices.text: Make sure their children use quality medicines.
choices.zh: 确保他们的孩子使用优质药物。

choices.text: Ask their children to use legitimate medicines.
choices.zh: 要求他们的孩子使用合法药物。
